textbookBox.concept: Adolescence (ages 10 to 19) is the crucial transition from childhood to adulthood, marked by rapid physical, mental, emotional, and social changes.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Adolescence (ages 10 to 19) is the crucial transition from childhood to adulthood, marked by rapid physical, mental, emotional, and social changes.

beats.en: Puberty activates growth and sex hormones, causing a growth spurt, body hair growth, active sweat and oil glands, voice change in boys, and menstruation in girls.
